title: 第10章 青蛇帮第11章 纷争
lines: 眼前的面板，没有给出任何响应。
楚生走在路上，低声自语道：“难道要把气血也跟上，才能进阶淬皮境？”
“没事，再来几天就够了！”
楚生自信满满道：“进入屠宰场成屠夫，果然是正确的选择，要是进武馆还不知道要练多久呢！”
“不过，黑虎帮的调查，还是不得不防！”
思虑间，楚生已经回到家门口，那是一个偏僻的地方，离后山很近。
家里仅有母亲一人！
大哥和小妹都出去做工，一个月只有几次回家的机会。
想到之前黑虎帮的调查，楚生瞬间担忧起来。
他若再去屠宰场，母亲一人在家，面对徐彪这些人，该如何是好？
次日清晨，楚生留下一两银子，叮嘱道：“母亲，要是黑虎帮的人过来，你把钱给他们就行，不要和他们纠缠。”
“好的，生儿，为娘明白！”龙珍把钱攥在手里，心疼不已。
楚生在腰间配上一把柴刀，没有带被褥，就离开了家。
路上，又看到黑虎帮的人在一家家盘查，和以前收例钱一样，只不过多了一段戏码。
“这黑虎帮真他妈黑心，不就死了一个小头目吗？又趁机敲诈我们钱财！”
“该死的黑虎帮，没用的官府，居然一点都不管……”
“官府管？你就庆幸官府巡捕现在没一起来要钱吧！”
“要说还得是青蛇帮的人仗义，只收一次例钱，他们还真把咱们老百姓当人，还保护老百姓呢，不像这只知道榨血的黑虎帮。”
“你怎么知道青蛇帮？”
“我一个表兄弟在城西区，是青蛇帮的地盘，他告诉我的！”
“要是我们也在青蛇帮领地就好了……”
“嘘！有人来了！”
见到楚生走近，两个粗布短衣的中年男人停止了交谈，谨慎地看向楚生。
殊不知，魂穿和面板加持过的楚生，灵魂感知力远超常人，对于方才的话听得清清楚楚。
青蛇帮，楚生知道，是城西一个等同于黑虎帮的势力。
因为两个帮派领地接近，经常发生摩擦，争抢地盘。
据楚生多年来所知道的情况，城北和城西分界处，青蛇帮的地盘可是扩张到了城北，青蛇帮隐隐沾了些许优势。
不经意间，楚生发现自己已经到了屠宰场。
“怎么没带被褥，宿舍可没给你准备被褥。”陈坤见到两手空空的楚生，淡淡说道。
楚生拱手解释道：“陈师，最近黑虎帮不知道发了什么疯，很是猖獗，我担心家中母亲的安危，所以能不能先住家里一段时间？”
念及楚生昨日的表现，陈坤耐心道：“倒也不是不行，但是必须完成屠宰场安排下来的任务。”
content_en:
The panel in front of me didn't give any response.
Chu Sheng walked on the road and whispered to himself: "Does it mean that the Qi and blood must also keep up in order to advance to the Skin Tempering Realm?"
"It's okay, just a few more days will be enough!"
Chu Sheng said confidently: "Entering the slaughterhouse and becoming a butcher is indeed the right choice. If you enter a martial arts gym, you don't know how long it will take to practice!"
"However, we still have to guard against the Black Tiger Gang's investigation!"
While thinking about it, Chu Sheng had already returned to the door. It was a remote place, very close to the back mountain.
There is only one mother in the family!
The eldest brother and the younger sister both go out to work and only have the opportunity to go home a few times a month.
Thinking of the previous investigation by the Black Tiger Gang, Chu Sheng instantly became worried.
If he goes to the slaughterhouse again and his mother is alone at home, what should he do if he faces people like Xu Biao?
…
Early the next morning, Chu Sheng left a tael of silver and warned: "Mother, if people from the Black Tiger Gang come over, just give them the money and don't get involved with them."
"Okay, give birth to a baby, I understand for my mother!" Long Zhen held the money in her hand, feeling heartbroken.
Chu Sheng put a hatchet on his waist and left home without a bedding.
On the way, I saw people from the Black Tiger Gang checking every house again. It was the same as collecting the money before, but with an extra drama.
"This Black Tiger Gang is so fucking evil. Didn't a small leader die? And they took the opportunity to extort money from us!"
"Damn Black Tiger Gang, useless government, they don't care at all..."
"Controlled by the government? Just be glad that the government patrols don't come to ask for money now!"
"It has to be said that the people of the Green Snake Gang are upright and only charge one-time payment. They really treat us people as human beings and protect them, unlike the Black Tiger Gang who only know how to extract blood."
"How do you know about the Green Snake Gang?"
"A cousin of mine is in the western district of the city, which is the territory of the Green Snake Gang. He told me!"
"It would be great if we were also in the Green Snake Gang's territory..."
"Shh! Someone is coming!"
Seeing Chu Sheng approaching, the two middle-aged men in coarse shorts stopped talking and looked at Chu Sheng cautiously.
As everyone knows, Chu Sheng, who has received soul penetration and panel blessing, has soul perception far beyond ordinary people, and he can clearly hear what he just said.
The Green Snake Gang, Chu Sheng knew, was a force equivalent to the Black Tiger Gang in the west of the city.
Because the two gangs' territories are close, frictions often occur and they compete for territory.
According to what Chu Sheng has known over the years, at the boundary between the north and west of the city, the Green Snake Gang's territory has expanded to the north of the city, and the Green Snake Gang has a slight advantage.
Inadvertently, Chu Sheng found that he had arrived at the slaughterhouse.
"Why didn't you bring a bedding? The dormitory didn't prepare bedding for you." Chen Kun said lightly when he saw Chu Sheng with empty hands.
Chu Sheng held up his hands and explained: "Master Chen, the Black Tiger Gang has gone crazy recently. It is very rampant. I am worried about the safety of my mother at home, so can I stay at home for a while?"
Thinking of Chu Sheng's performance yesterday, Chen Kun said patiently: "It's not impossible, but we must complete the tasks assigned by the slaughterhouse."
title_en: Chapter 10 Green Snake Gang Chapter 11 Dispute
